name: zinterp_context_default_dispatch_hook
description: zInterp_Context::DefaultDispatchHook is the default false dispatch hook and preserves the original null-node behavior.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
The original non-null path calls gwNodeGetUserData with a null output pointer, which is crash-equivalent with the current provider implementation and is not executed by the native smoke.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4c58c0 validates loading the node stack argument, skipping work for a null node, calling zClass_Class::gwNodeGetUserData(node, NULL) for a non-null node, returning AL=0, and callee-cleaning the single stack argument.
The native smoke verifies the null-node default hook return value used by safe dispatch paths.
